content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital store stack that operates independently of payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. It’s built on open tools: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. The buyer sends crypto directly from their wallet—no accounts required. The moment the payment confirms on-chain, a webhook triggers instant product delivery. You own the entire stack. No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. No one can shut it down. This is infrastructure sovereignty: you control the tools, the data, and the revenue stream.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it works step-by-step: 1. Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both are free and globally distributed. 2. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools process orders, verify payments, and trigger product delivery. 3. Orders are stored in Supabase (a serverless database) or Google Sheets for simplicity. 4. Product files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. NOWPayments handles crypto payments. It converts the price to the buyer’s chosen cryptocurrency at transaction time. When payment confirms on-chain, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your backend. The backend verifies the payment, logs the order, and sends a download link to the buyer. The entire process is automated, secure, and transparent. You don’t touch crypto—NOWPayments handles conversion to USD or your preferred currency.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, and you’ve been locked out of Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Paddle, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want full control over their sales process—no platform fees, no data harvesting, no shutdown risks. The architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm. It works in Kenya, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and beyond. If you’re tired of workarounds and want a permanent solution, this is your stack.
Sovereign commerce is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure you own.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack is chosen for its reliability, cost, and ease of use. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are free, fast, and globally distributed. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script are serverless, meaning they scale automatically and cost almost nothing to run. Supabase and Google Sheets provide flexible order storage. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 are secure, affordable file storage solutions. NOWPayments is the payment gateway—it supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, charges only 0.5% per transaction, and requires no KYC. The recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON—transactions cost under $0.10. These tools work together seamlessly, giving you a fully operational store without dependencies on third-party platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign store, start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant access to the source code. If you prefer a done-for-you solution, choose the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). The Starter Stack deploys in 48 hours using GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Stack uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. Both include 30-day support. If you want to build it yourself, start with the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation and source code. Either way, you’ll own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Just sovereign commerce.

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), Edge Commerce Stack ($197), or Complete Builder Kit ($197). 2. Purchase the stack at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 3. Provide your product details (title, description, price) and files. 4. For done-for-you stacks, COREMERCH deploys your store within 48 hours. 5. For self-build, follow the Sovereign Blueprint documentation to set up hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. 6. Test the entire flow: place a test order, verify payment, and ensure product delivery works. 7. Launch your store and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’ve never worked with crypto before?
Yes. NOWPayments handles crypto conversion automatically. You receive payments in USD or your preferred currency. Buyers pay with crypto, but you don’t need to hold or manage it.
What if my customers don’t have crypto?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Buyers can use any wallet or exchange to send payment. The process is simple and requires no account setup.
How much does it cost to run this infrastructure?
Hosting, backend logic, and storage are free or low-cost. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10 per transaction.
Can I scale this as my business grows?
Yes. The architecture is designed to scale. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase handle high traffic, and NOWPayments supports unlimited transactions.
What happens if I need support after deployment?
All stacks include 30-day support. For ongoing assistance, COREMERCH offers additional support packages. The Complete Builder Kit includes full documentation for self-maintenance.
